stemMd: For which $m$ does $mx+6=2x+1$ have no solution?
explanationMd: Rearrange to $(m-2)x=-5$. With $m=2$ the equation says $0=-5$, impossible. Every other coefficient gives one real solution.

distractorRationale.c: Confuses the right-side constant with the slope.
distractorRationale.a: Uses the constant difference as the coefficient.
distractorRationale.b: A zero original coefficient still leaves a nonzero coefficient after rearrangement.
